task:
[1] Use chrome-use to connect to the user's existing Chrome. STRICT rules (repeatedly violated before — do not repeat):
1. Use exactly ONE tab. Navigate studio.youtube.com in place if a tab already exists there; otherwise open exactly one new tab.
2. NEVER use a document-wide/generic selector or synthetic DOM event dispatch on the videos list page. Any interaction with the file input must be scoped to that specific dialog's node only, using DOM.setFileInputFiles (via CDP) on the exact input[type=file] node found within the upload dialog's DOM subtree — never document.querySelector('input[type=file]') broadly, since a prior attempt's synthetic change event bubbled into the video-list and triggered "select all" + risked bulk delete on live videos.
3. Screenshot after every single action (click, dialog open, file set) before proceeding to the next.
4. If at ANY point you see checkboxes getting selected on the video list, or any bulk-action bar/toolbar appearing, STOP IMMEDIATELY, screenshot it, and report — do not try to undo it yourself with more clicks.
5. Close the tab when done (or leave on safe dashboard page if Chrome refuses to close the last tab).

Task:
1. Navigate to studio.youtube.com (Vibe Technologies channel dashboard root — NOT the videos list, avoid that page entirely this time to sidestep the checkbox risk).
2. Click "Create" button (top right) -> "Upload videos" option. This opens a modal dialog (NOT the videos list page).
3. Within that modal's DOM only, find the input[type=file] node. Get its precise DOM path/nodeId via CDP (DOM.describeNode or similar), then use DOM.setFileInputFiles scoped exactly to that nodeId with file path /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4. Do NOT touch anything outside this modal.
4. Screenshot to confirm the file attached (should show video thumbnail/filename in the modal).
5. Proceed through the upload wizard: Title "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts", Description "Chat with an AI coding assistant from your phone. Connect to your own opencode server, or try the built-in demo. Free & open source. #opencode #AI #coding #mobiledev #Shorts", Visibility: Public. Use defaults for all other wizard steps (skip monetization, etc).
6. Publish.
7. Get the video ID/Short URL from the publish confirmation dialog.
8. Screenshot the confirmation.
9. Close the modal/tab, return to a safe page.

If the CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles approach isn't available in your toolset (only synthetic-event-based upload is), STOP immediately and report that limitation precisely — don't fall back to the risky method. In that case also capture a screenshot of the upload dialog's raw DOM/HTML (e.g. via an eval that only reads outerHTML of the dialog, no writes) as evidence for a GitHub issue.

Return: new video ID/URL if successful, OR precise blocker + DOM evidence if not, screenshot paths, final tab state.

[2] Give me the FULL detailed report now, not a one-line summary:
1. Did you reach studio.youtube.com dashboard? What did you see?
2. Did you click Create -> Upload videos? Did the modal open?
3. Could you locate the input[type=file] node via CDP DOM methods? Yes/No — what happened when you tried?
4. Was DOM.setFileInputFiles available/usable in your toolset? Yes/No.
5. What exactly does "non-stable, contended browser session" mean here — was another process interfering again?
6. Any screenshots taken? Give paths.
7. Final tab state — how many tabs, what URLs.
